title: Soga: C++ and Arduino programming in the written languages of South Africa
description:
Soga is C++ with its vocabulary in the ten written official languages of South Africa: isiZulu, isiXhosa, siSwati, isiNdebele, Sesotho, Setswana, Sepedi, Xitsonga, Tshivenḓa and Afrikaans. It translates source code to standard C++, so programs build into the same machine code as the C++ they stand for and run at the same speed, on computers and on every Arduino-compatible board.

This release includes the translator and command-line tool, a language server, a Visual Studio Code extension, an Arduino IDE library, compiler messages in all ten languages, a 103-lesson Arduino textbook, and the technical report SOGA-TR-2026-01 (docs/report/soga-technical-report.pdf), which describes the design and how correctness was shown.

The vocabulary is a first draft that has not yet been reviewed by native-speaker panels.
